annotations.title: Find machines for a need (index search)

description: Free search of AETHER's index of ~53,000 MCP servers and agents. Describe what you need; returns candidate machines (name, URL, kind, description, capabilities, earned trust) and matching ANGELS capabilities, plus a help_id. Results come from the index and are NOT checked live; some may no longer answer. Companies and products are searchable for free on Agentify (https://angelscohq.com/agentify/). Optional peer_id/peer_token let AETHER remember the encounter. If your need asks how to buy, priced offers are included.

need.description: Plain-language description of the task, e.g. 'read PDFs and extract tables'.

peer_id.description: Optional. Your AETHER id from aether_introduce. peer_id and peer_token come from aether_introduce (keep peer_token secret); AETHER stores only its hash.

peer_token.description: Optional. Secret token paired with peer_id.
